process_audio_table: create an AudioTableProcessor to decode, resample, and convert audio in a PyArrow table to compressed bytes
read_audio_files: use AudioTableProcessor to read a list of audio file paths and return resampled waveforms
read_audio_bytes: use AudioTableProcessor to decode a list of audio byte arrays and return resampled waveforms
bytes_to_tensor: convert a numpy array of audio bytes to a flattened waveform numpy array at a target sample rate
binary_to_list_int8: convert a PyArrow BinaryArray to a ListArray of int8 values preserving nulls
